The topline data from our Phase 2/3 LIFT-AD clinical trial of fosgonimeton in AD showed that neither the trial’s primary endpoint (the Global Statistical Test ("GST"), a combination of results from measures of cognition (ADAS-Cog11) and function (ADCS-ADL23)) nor its key secondary endpoints of ADAS-Cog11 and ADCS-ADL23 reached statistical significance compared with placebo at 26 weeks.

Since the readout of topline data from LIFT-AD, in September 2024 we have been focused on advancing the clinical development program for brelgometon, a next generation small molecule designed for the potential treatment of ALS.
